title: Gateway staging: a DECIMAL value can be written in scientific notation

found.by: lfc-schema-change-test gateway-staging samples: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard CDC, utility 1.7, serverless gateway

symptom: DECIMAL(38,10) -0.0000000001 is staged as the string "-1E-10"
cause: decimals are staged as strings in their shortest form, which uses an exponent for small values
effect: a parser that expects plain digits rejects or misreads the value
fix: parse with an exponent-aware decimal parser (Python Decimal, Spark CAST to DECIMAL) into the schema file's precision and scale
